title: Agoda prices
description: Three row types share one dataset: hotel (one property with its cheapest rate for the stay, charged when priced), calendar (one check-in date of a property's price calendar, charged when priced) and status (per destination or property, free).

type.description: Row type: hotel, calendar or status.

mode.description: destination (from a location search) or property (a named hotel).

query.description: The input this row came from: the destination, URL, id or name.

target.description: Status rows: the input the row reports on.

hotel_name.description: Property name in the requested locale.

stars.description: Star rating, 1-5; null when Agoda shows none.

review_score.description: Combined guest score across every review source Agoda aggregates, 0-10.

agoda_score.description: Guest score from Agoda's own reviews only, 0-10.

check_in.description: Check-in date the price is quoted for (YYYY-MM-DD).

adults.description: Adults the price is quoted for.

children.description: Children the price is quoted for.

rooms.description: Rooms the price is quoted for.

currency.description: ISO currency of every price in the row.

price_nightly.description: Cheapest rate per room per night before taxes and fees — Agoda's default display price.

price_nightly_with_taxes.description: The same nightly rate with taxes and fees included.

price_total.description: Total for the whole booking (all rooms, all nights) before taxes and fees. Calendar rows: nightly price × nights.

price_total_with_taxes.description: Total for the whole booking with taxes and fees included.

crossed_out_price.description: The struck-through nightly price when Agoda shows a discount; null otherwise.

available_rooms.description: Rooms left at the cheapest rate, as Agoda reports it.

cancellation.description: Agoda's cancellation term for the cheapest rate: FreeCancellation, NonRefundable or SpecialConditions.

free_cancellation.description: True when the cheapest rate is free to cancel.

free_cancellation_until.description: Deadline for free cancellation when Agoda states one.

breakfast_included.description: True when Agoda flags breakfast in the cheapest rate's benefits.

benefit_ids.description: Agoda's benefit ids attached to the cheapest rate (breakfast, free WiFi, parking…), raw.

supplier_id.description: Agoda's id for the supplier of the cheapest rate.

payment_model.description: How the cheapest rate is paid, e.g. MerchantCommission.

sold_out.description: True when Agoda lists the property but has no rate for the stay (row is free).

rank.description: Position in the destination's results under `sort` (1 = first). Null for named properties.

sort.description: The sort the destination search used.

price_source.description: search — the price came from Agoda's search results for the stay.

trend.description: Calendar rows: Agoda's Low, Normal or High flag for the date.

rank_in_window.description: Calendar rows: 1 = the cheapest check-in date in the window.

cheapest_in_window.description: Calendar rows: true on the cheapest date of the window.

status.description: Status rows: ok, no_results, sold_out, not_found or error.

hotels.description: Status rows: priced hotel rows delivered for this input.

sold_out_hotels.description: Status rows: properties listed but unpriced for the stay (free, written only with includeSoldOut).

filtered.description: Status rows: priced hotels a filter removed (never billed).

pages.description: Status rows: result pages read for a destination.

calendar_days.description: Status rows: calendar rows delivered for a property.

duplicates.description: Status rows: properties already delivered by an earlier input in this run.

error.description: Status rows: why an input failed.

fetched_at.description: UTC time the row was collected.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.description: Every priced hotel row for the stay, in result order.

cheapest.title: Cheapest first
cheapest.description: Priced hotels with the lowest nightly rate at the top.

calendar.title: Price calendar
calendar.description: Per-date prices for named properties, cheapest date ranked first.

status.title: Status
status.description: One row per destination or property: what was delivered, filtered, sold out or failed.
